statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let M := fun X : ℕ => (X:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; let R := fun n : ℕ => ((H n + H (n+2)):ℝ); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n ∈ E X, M X ≤ b n) ∧ (∑ n ∈ E X, (R n-b n)^2) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)*(M X)^2

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：相邻中央命中的局部主项具有低均方误差
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: low mean-square error for adjacent central arrivals

brief.zh: 用局部因子构造预测。允许例外，控制误差平方总量；下游用已证的漏点能量引理。
brief.en: Build a local-factor predictor. Exceptions are allowed; bound the squared errors in aggregate.
